rationale: Both use the same data tables and the same Verses and Song. A's Verse builds every 'She swallowed X to catch Y' line from one template and adds the spider suffix when the caught creature is the spider. It guards the cumulative section once and reuses comments[0] for the closing line. B hardcodes the whole bird/spider line under a magic 'i == 3' check, folds the bounds condition into the for-loop header, repeats that same condition for the final line, and duplicates the fly comment as a literal instead of reusing comments[0]. A is more data-driven and less duplicated.
